description: Latest and historical euro foreign exchange reference rates from the European Central Bank, with conversion between any two of its currencies. Cost: 1 credit per call. Output: JSON. latest: {base, date, rates}; convert: {amount, from, to, rate, result, date_used}; history: {base, quote, series[{date, rate}]}

base.description: Base currency (latest, history); for convert the alias of 'from'

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; non-business days use the previous business day. Default: latest day

days.description: history: calendar days ending at 'date' (default the latest day)

quote.description: Quote currency (history; latest filter; convert alias of 'to')

quotes.description: Several quote currencies for latest; omit for all

name: currency_rates
title: Currency exchange rates (ECB)
